items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Senator Lebeau called me, he said... 'I want to take you and your wife to dinner at the Roosevelt.'

ctx.x: waiting for the Senator, you'all can do. But I ain't goin'. I'm gonna stay home." Now you can take over.

Now, what happened, Paul said, "Man, that's wonderful, because Senator Lebeau has got gangs of station wagons. We were using Paul's little truck. That's before we got the bus. He had a little small station wagon. But it was hard carrying seven musicians and her. So we all piled up in this little...
We made a little thing like a wagon in the back of the station wagon.
